## Day 2 — policy session

Proposed panel for the moderated round table: DG CNECT, DG SANTE, DG DEFIS, DG RTD
(institutions and named speakers to be confirmed), plus one scientific voice from the
workshop. Short interventions expected from Tolias (DG SANTE) and Domps (DG DEFIS).
Moderator to be confirmed.

## Day 2 — working-table contributors

Day 2 morning's parallel working tables draw on a mix of scientific contributors,
facilitators and rapporteurs. The list below is indicative and subject to change as
attendance and interests are confirmed — see [Problems](problems/index.qmd) for the
table themes.

| Working table | Possible scientific contributors |
|---|---|
| 1 — Large-scale bioinformatics/genomics, NP-hard problems | Zev Kronenberg, Aurora Maurizio, Miguel Ponce de Leon |
| 2 — AI / QML | Francesco Zamponi, Guglielmo Mazzola, Hao Wang |
| 3 — Radiotherapy and other hard health problems | Carlo Mancini Terracciano, Diego Reforgiato Recupero, Miguel A. Gonzalez Ballester |
| 4 — Benchmark framework | Federico Ricci-Tersenghi, Vito Palmisano, Gabriele Spada, Vedran Dunjko (if confirmed) |

Note: Daniel J. Egger will not be present on Day 2.
